scope: Browser navigation, deployment draft recovery and actionable operation failures

checks.name: TypeScript and production frontend
checks.command: npm run check && npm run build

checks.name: Unit and HTTP integration tests
checks.details: Includes source/job restoration, account isolation, failure stages, provider-message redaction, HTTP health failures, fresh approval on retry and no mutation replay.

checks.name: Chrome recovery and navigation with simulated providers
checks.details: Drafts, source restore, direct job URLs, Settings return, Back/Forward, review regeneration, missing sources, late async responses and secret exclusion.

checks.name: Chrome failure screens with simulated providers
checks.details: Legacy HTTP 409, visible provider error and failed stage, edit/review retry, uncertain-outcome verification, 320px and 390px layouts; no browser errors or provider writes.

checks.name: Docker image and running app
checks.details: Built from cached dependencies; restarted with no running jobs. Existing account/team connection restored. Health endpoint returns HTTP 200 and current frontend assets match the local build.

checks.name: Running app recovery in Chrome and HTTP
checks.details: Actual recorded test1 failure is visible; direct job URL survives refresh and Settings return. Saved source metadata and old-job endpoints return successfully. No browser errors.

notRun: New live Liara app creation or deployment; provider writes were simulated
